text: Monitor AI-specific and open-source funding calls for a genuinely eligible Q4 opportunity
description: Maintain a monthly, source-verified scan of German/EU AI and open-source funding that is actually open and structurally eligible. Current July 2026 result: no better individual AI-specific grant is open for Aimparency. SPRIND Next Frontier AI closed 1 June and funds frontier-model research rather than an application/tool layer; the former BMWE Gründungswettbewerb is not currently continued; many BMFTR AI calls require companies/research consortia or are already closed. Watch: new SPRIND challenges, BMFTR software/AI calls, KMU-innovativ IKT after a legal entity exists, EIC Open at greater maturity, and NLnet's regular open calls when they reopen after summer. Never treat a search listing as open until the official call page confirms deadline and eligibility.

reflections.context: Felix requested current ways to fund continued Aimparency work; several existing graph claims predated July 2026 program changes.
reflections.outcome: Verified official sources and created meta/funding-landscape-2026-07-22.md. Prototype Fund remains the strongest individual route; NLnet's general call is paused until after summer; EXIST is conditional on founder/university eligibility; Pro FIT and BayTOU depend on company location; ZIM stopped ordinary applications on 7 July 2026. Updated the funding parent and ZIM child accordingly.
reflections.effectiveness: The graph no longer ranks a currently unavailable ZIM submission as its first route and explicitly keeps paid customer diagnostics alongside grants as real survival evidence.
reflections.lesson: Funding monitoring must treat official availability, applicant identity, geography, and timing as first-class state; a technically suitable program is not an actionable opportunity while paused or structurally ineligible.

reflections.context: First Q4 recheck (2026-09-30), official NLnet pages plus search for Prototype Fund.
reflections.outcome: NLnet has reopened with two thematic calls, both closing 3 November 2026 12:00 CET, €5k–50k, results under a free/open-source license. Restack Fund (operational internet commons incl. productivity tools; €7M through 2030) is a candidate, but it explicitly excludes AI projects unless they already serve over 1M users. Aimparency would have to be framed as an open planning/productivity tool with the agent layer secondary, which is a framing decision for Felix. CodeSupply Fund (software supply-chain security metadata) does not fit. Prototype Fund: the official site returned 403 to automated fetches and search only surfaced older rounds, so no verified current deadline.
reflections.effectiveness: Verified from official NLnet call pages; Prototype Fund status remains unverified and must be checked by a human in a browser.
reflections.lesson: NLnet's general call was replaced by thematic funds with shared deadlines; check each fund's exclusions (here, the AI exclusion) before treating it as an opportunity.

status.comment: Sept 30 recheck: NLnet Restack Fund (deadline 3 Nov 2026 noon CET, €5k–50k) is a possible fit only if Aimparency is framed as a productivity tool, since AI projects under 1M users are excluded; Felix to decide. CodeSupply is off-topic. Prototype Fund round/deadline unverified (site blocks automated access). Next recheck: late October.
